description: Test suite for usage accumulator functions, verifying their correctness in aggregating, normalizing, and resolving usage metrics related to API calls.

methods.name: createUsageAccumulator
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new usage accumulator object.

methods.name: mergeUsageIntoAccumulator
methods.description: Aggregates a usage measurement into the accumulator, updating totals and last call snapshot.

methods.name: resolveLastCallUsage
methods.description: Resolves and returns the last call usage metrics, preferring raw assistant data when available.

methods.name: toLastCallUsage
methods.description: Returns the last call usage snapshot from the accumulator.

methods.name: toNormalizedUsage
methods.description: Converts the accumulator data into a normalized usage object suitable for billing.
